text:
anna-partnerops: Quick sync — we need a final asset handoff matrix for the Nimbus marketplace listing and partner co-marketing. Who owns the landing page copy vs partner-provided screenshots?

mike-marketing: I can take landing copy & hero messaging. Need partner-approved screenshots + logos by EOD Thursday.

lina-prod: Integration readiness note: SI team needs the sample config and SSO flow docs to validate before we publish. ETA Wednesday for docs if we get the API keys today.

anna-partnerops: @mike-marketing noted. @lina-prod I'll push keys via secure link once legal signs off on the NDA addendum.

sam-legal: I've reviewed the addendum. Two small changes: explicit logging clause and usage telemetry opt-out language. Pushing edits to the shared doc now.

jess-sales: Partner asked for co-branded demo video — can marketing produce 30s cut? They need the script by Friday.

mike-marketing: Yes, 30s cut is doable. I'll draft the script and start a Loom storyboard. Who owns the partner quote?

anna-partnerops: Partner will provide a quote but needs a sign-off pass. I'll collect and paste into the handoff matrix.

deploy-bot: Reminder: marketplace-prod branch deploy scheduled for 2469123600 — freeze window 30m before.

lina-prod: Dev note: for the marketplace tile we must include the region tags and pricing tier mappings. @anna-partnerops can you confirm required tiers?

anna-partnerops: Required tiers = Free tier (trial), Starter, Enterprise (with Dedicated). I'll add SKU mapping in the sheet.

mike-marketing: Press cadence question: partner prefers embargo until Monday 09:00 PT. Do we want to align Redwood PR or stagger? Suggest Redwood embargo at same time for joint announcement. Thoughts?

sam-legal: Aligning embargo simplifies approvals. Need final quotes and legal sign-off 48 hours before embargo to meet timelines.

jess-sales: Sales enablement: request a one-page integration playbook and battlecard. Can we commit to delivery by launch day?

lina-prod: Integration playbook draft will be ready; battlecard can be a one-pager derived from that. We can do it by launch day if marketing provides the final messaging by Friday.

anna-partnerops: I'll assemble a delivery checklist. Items: landing copy (marketing), screenshots (partner), logos + trademark ok (legal), sample config + API keys (prod), demo video script (marketing), quotes (partner), playbook + battlecard (prod/sales).

mike-marketing: Action: I'll own landing copy + demo script. Posting draft link in #drive: https://drive.redwood/example (placeholder).

sam-legal: Action: I've uploaded NDA edits to the legal doc and pinged partner counsel. Please don't share keys until they countersign.

jess-sales: Action: I'll build the partner FAQ stub for the marketplace tile — need expected support SLAs and escalation path.

anna-partnerops: Final question: analytics tags — do we want one UTM for joint campaign or separate UTMs per audience?

mike-marketing: Use separate UTMs for marketplaces vs direct campaigns but a shared utm_campaign value so we can tie reports together. Example: utm_source=marketplace, utm_campaign=nimbus-launch-joint.

lina-prod: One technical blocker: the marketplace listing requires the integration to support oauth scopes: profile,email,org.read. We currently only return profile and email. Can we add org.read by Thursday?

anna-partnerops: Noted — putting org.read as priority P1 for the SI team.

mike-marketing: Timeline recap: 
- Wed: sample config + keys to SI (once NDA done)
- Thu EOD: partner screenshots + logos + org.read implemented
- Fri: landing copy + demo script draft + quotes collected
- Mon 09:00 PT: embargo lift & joint announcement

sam-legal: Confirmed timeline works if partner signs addendum by Tue noon.

jess-sales: I'll schedule a 30-min prelaunch enablement session Mon 10:00 PT + record.

anna-partnerops: Great. I'll update the handoff matrix and ping for missing items. Please react with :thumbsup: when you own an action.

mike-marketing: :thumbsup: (owning landing copy + demo)

lina-prod: :thumbsup: (org.read + playbook)

sam-legal: :thumbsup: (legal sign-off)

jess-sales: :thumbsup: (enablement & FAQ)

anna-partnerops: Thanks team — I'll send the final matrix and link to the shared folder after this thread.
